identity: Exact effect object, caster and live carrier on CPU; slot plus entry generation on GPU. A missing, removed or different carrier never falls back to a sibling.
activation: One shared nested carrier context for ordinary and protection activation. Context restores after nested events and exceptions. Numerical handlers retain their existing phases.
initialization: Four checked preparation anchors: new carrier, two refresh paths, instant stack initialization. Initial HP synchronization is an explicit catalog policy separate from a current-HP grant.
quantity_binding: Damage-cap and max-HP numerical continuation, activation value logging and registered resource pools use the lexical activated carrier. Storage cold initialization receives the exact requested carrier explicitly.
partial_removal: Max-HP grants use the carrier recipients remaining after child notifications. Removed parent plus replacement in the same slot does not inherit the parent continuation.
generic_executor: Existing battle/weapon/timer interpreter remains; this change consolidates lifecycle identity and event/state adapters. No character-name numerical branches added.
workspace: 1103888 bytes/squad expected, unchanged; no CUDA State fields added.
GPU_evidence: Native eight carrier plus nineteen copy cases; portable eight plus nine; full native 216 methods with zero failures/skips, source stable; normal owned API and three raw-copy preview cases passed.
sources: Existing operation contracts remain authoritative; fixing an admitted multi-instance identity defect does not assert new in-game snapshot/refresh semantics.
tests: One table-driven CPU callback probe, one actual activation table, seven distinct-recipient squad fixtures delegated to existing family comparators, one independent max-HP parent replacement case. Existing copy witnesses run in the same full acceptance once. Fast is a subset, not an additional total.
future_additions: Existing operation: data/mapping changes plus a representative raw squad. New operation: explicit lifecycle metadata, numerical handler and only missing quantity/order witnesses. current_instance=True and generated dispatch audited before acceptance.
